source.title: Interoceptive inference, emotion, and the embodied self

confidence_rationale: Seth's interoceptive-inference framework recasts subjective feelings as inferences from a generative (predictive) model of the causes of interoceptive afferents -- i.e. the satisfaction/affective state is a MODELLED quantity, not a raw read-out. This is the closest existing theory to MECH-214's claim that a goal's satisfaction referent must be E1-representable (model-representable) for the goal to be coherent, and it unifies interoceptive selfhood with the same predictive-coding machinery SD-030/MECH-215 use on the motor side. Held at 0.64: a strong conceptual unification but a framework, not a REE-specific result; INV-064 mapping is weak.
failure_signatures: If the generative model of interoceptive causes is impoverished, the satisfaction state a goal targets is not inferable -- wanting fires on a state the agent cannot model, the MECH-214 failure mode stated in predictive-coding terms.

Body ownership and emotion are recast as the SAME interoceptive-inference process -- so a self-model that infers exteroceptive self-state but not interoceptive self-state would dissociate agency-capacity from affective grounding (the MECH-215 capacity-vs-affect gap), and the rubber-hand illusion has an interoceptive-precision modulator.

Selfhood is developmentally built from interoceptive inference; a system that scores viability (E3) before its interoceptive generative model is differentiated evaluates against an undefined affective subject -- the structural shape of INV-064's lower-layer-before-higher-layer prerequisite (weak/analogical).

mapping.source_claim_statement: Subjective feeling states (emotions) arise from actively-inferred generative (predictive) models of the causes of interoceptive afferent signals; this 'interoceptive inference' generalises appraisal theories and underlies the experience of body ownership and conscious selfhood in health and neuropsychiatric illness.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-214 requires a goal's satisfaction referent to be E1-representable; Seth makes that referent a MODELLED quantity -- the satisfaction/affective state is the output of a generative model over interoceptive causes, so 'E1-representable' becomes 'inferable by the interoceptive generative model'. When that model is impoverished, the satisfaction state cannot be inferred and wanting decouples from its hedonic grounding (the MECH-214 addiction/anhedonia mapping). The same predictive-coding form unifies this with SD-030/MECH-215 on the motor side: one comparator architecture, two streams (motor-self and interoceptive-self).
mapping.mapping_caveat: A theoretical/computational framework, not a REE experiment; it strengthens the CONCEPTUAL coherence of the MECH-214 channel (and ties the self-model's interoceptive and motor halves under one predictive-coding roof) but tests nothing in REE. The INV-064 tag is weak -- Seth notes selfhood DEVELOPS from interoceptive inference, which rhymes with the maturational-prerequisite logic, but does not test the E1->E2->E3 necessity claim. Free-energy/active-inference framing is adjacent to but not identical with REE's E1/E2/E3 decomposition.
mapping.source_context: Theoretical cognitive neuroscience; predictive-coding / active-inference account of interoception, emotion, and selfhood.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (influential TICS framework, foundational for interoceptive predictive processing). Mapping fidelity good for MECH-214 (the satisfaction referent as a modelled/inferable quantity is almost a restatement of E1-representability) and decent for MECH-215; weak for INV-064 (developmental remark, not the necessity claim). Transfer risk low-moderate: predictive-coding self maps onto REE's generative E1/E2 at the framework level.
